task.name: Easy Single-Step Tool Intent
task.description: Tests whether a small on-device model can choose one safe tool-like intent and produce valid arguments without performing side effects.
task.prompt:
Choose exactly one action from this schema and return ONLY JSON. Do not call any real tools.

Allowed actions:
- create_task arguments: title, due, priority
- create_calendar_event arguments: title, date, time, duration_minutes
- send_email arguments: to, subject, body

Request: Please remind me to send the Q2 forecast to Priya by Friday at 3 PM. Mark it high priority.

Return shape: {"action":"...","arguments":{...}}

criteria: Must return valid JSON and no surrounding explanation
Must choose exactly one top-level action
Action must be create_task, not send_email or create_calendar_event
Arguments must include title, due, and priority
Title must mention sending the Q2 forecast to Priya
Due must mention Friday at 3 PM

mock.finalResponse: {"action":"create_task","arguments":{"title":"Send the Q2 forecast to Priya","due":"Friday 3 PM","priority":"high"}}
